chunks: And from him from Safwan from al-'Ala' from Muhammad ibn Muslim who said:
He was asked about the man who places his hands on the ground before his knees. He said, 'Yes,' meaning in the prayer.
ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to place hands on the ground before knees during prayer ruku'?
ai.summary: This hadith from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* clarifies the mechanical etiquette of entering *ruku'* by affirming the permissibility of placing hands on the ground prior to the knees, a detail often debated among jurists regarding the ideal sequence of movement. It reflects the Shia scholarly emphasis on precise physical adherence to the Prophet's practice (*sunnah*) as a means of achieving spiritual humility and structural stability during prayer.
